{"CommandLine":"python -c "
import os, urllib.request, pdfplumber

pdf_path = os.path.join('scratch', 'api_compendium_2021.pdf')
if not os.path.exists(pdf_path):
    print('Downloading PDF...')
    url = 'https://www.api.org/-/media/files/policy/esg/ghg/2021-api-ghg-compendium-110921.pdf'
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp, open(pdf_path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(resp.read())
    print('Downloaded', os.path.getsize(pdf_path), 'bytes')
else:
    print('Already exists:', os.path.getsize(pdf_path), 'bytes')

with pdfplumber.open(pdf_path) as pdf:
    print('Total pages:', len(pdf.pages))
    # Search for '6.2.3 Well Completions'
    found_pages = []
    for i, p in enumerate(pdf.pages):
        text = p.extract_text() or ''
        if '6.2.3' in text and 'Well Completion' in text:
            found_pages.append(i)
            print(f'Found on page {i+1}')
